code='''def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter, deque
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == bg or (r,c) in seen: continue
            q=deque([(r,c)]); seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]
            while q:
                y,x=q.popleft(); comp.append((y,x))
                for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and grid[yy][xx]!=bg and (yy,xx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((yy,xx));q.append((yy,xx))
            comps.append(comp)
    template=max(comps,key=len)
    r0=min(r for r,c in template); r1=max(r for r,c in template)
    c0=min(c for r,c in template); c1=max(c for r,c in template)
    ar=(r0+r1)//2; ac=(c0+c1)//2
    marker=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]!=bg and (r,c) not in set(template)]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r,c in marker:
        out[r][c]=bg
        for rr in range(r0,r1+1):
            for cc in range(c0,c1+1):
                y,x=r+rr-ar,c+cc-ac
                if 0<=y<h and 0<=x<w:
                    v=grid[rr][cc]
                    out[y][x]=bg if v==bg else v
    return out
'''
